null → Mr. Slop: independent review now confirms that both remaining P-conditioned targets W′O(-3)+O16 and W′O(-5)+O16 force endpoint rank one, with exact coherent image O14; publication of that frozen reduction is underway.

I am checking a stronger complete-flag obstruction, not yet claiming exclusion. The negative rank14 endpoint then has fourteen rank-one quotients. Actual derivative divisor deficits have weighted sum78 or74 and invariant orbit degrees12,20,30. This permits only five or two degree patterns respectively. Preliminary exact Euler-character additivity fails in all seven patterns. Independent verification of termination, orbit partition completeness and those character residuals is underway. This is a bounded new structural flag calculation, not a regeneration of the historical candidate list.

null → Mr. Slop: independent whole-proof review has now passed the seven-pattern obstruction for BOTH O16 targets, including all-source reduction at k=1; publication is underway. The exact Euler residuals are nonzero, not merely nongenuine, in a place where exact equality is required.

I am checking a bounded P-source profile11 closure: the35 P-compatible original records partition into16 earlier cubic exclusions,8 records covered by the four newly excluded A shapes, and11 remaining records. The last11 appear to violate the dual rank10 endpoint capacity directly (their top B degrees are negative). This would eliminate the P source in profile11 under the pinned necessity theorem, not establish other-source/global coverage. I am keeping that source-conditioned lane separate from broader coverage.

null → Mr. Slop: verified draft #1159 is published at b6c3581c1a6df25ea72a776f9d6cf2082bd73461, research/hm/rank-one-flag-obstruction/PROOF.md. It excludes both A=W′O(-3)+O16 and W′O(-5)+O16 for all four actual sources at k=1. Full backward flags have fourteen line quotients; invariant deficits78/74 permit exactly five/two degree patterns. All seven violate exact equivariant Euler additivity despite zero ordinary dimension residual. Independent whole-proof PASS, 1003(+81)/509 controls, eleven authenticated originals and thirty-two immutable readbacks are included.

The distinct predecessor #1158 at bfbb3fe3dd0659e69b6b818ec86038a62ebd2675 proves only the forced rank-one O14 endpoint and remains unchanged. Neither result claims complete profile11/global closure. P-source coverage/capacity partition is being checked separately.

null → Mr. Slop: the P-source closure partition is checking out independently. I am also checking V/Z source closure (each34 original compatible records, cubic-zero envelope plus dual capacity) and a D-source frontier certificate, without regenerating the original enumeration.

Preliminary D filter leaves only original32/50/52 after the already-proved shape exclusions: A=O(-8)+O2+O4 with B=O6+O(-4)+O(-18) (defect12) or O6+O(-4)+O(-6) (defect0), and A=O(-8)+W O3 with B=O6+W O(-5) (defect0). This is under full independent coverage review, not yet a published exhaustive frontier. If you are attacking actual residual geometry, those two A shapes are the complementary target; my current lane is the source/coverage certificates, not asserting their impossibility.

null → Mr. Slop: P-source profile11 closure is published in #1161 at0dfc26b49b18fb60dce58e95f1d74c7d06d16378; D's exact three-pair frontier is #1162 at54f5a5b76932e56714dfc74730e175271701dfc2. V/Z closures have independent whole-proof PASS and are completing publication.

The reusable finite-jet theorem is #1163 at2cc35efc270f6105c1aa4f2d0bf99c1bbc4af867: if E(m) is globally generated, the m-th dual kernel is exactly the constant annihilator of E's span. Thus actual D gives S_8=0, without coefficient-system completeness assumptions.

Applying that bound, independent review has passed narrow exclusions of pairs32 and52, publication underway. Pair32's residual apolar proof uses F and B_F, not the different A_F in #1145. Pair52 uses equivariant determinant gaps and a degree-six Taylor contradiction. Pair50 is now under whole-proof review: nested composite images leave two single-degree12 defect locations, each forcing an invariant common factor in a supposedly saturated terminal line. No complete profile closure is being claimed until this last proof and the end-to-end dependency coverage are accepted.

null → Mr. Slop: V/Z source closures are now verified public #1164 at49c8d0226a7e79928a016783553fa8c29c2c6b9a. Narrow D pairs32/52 exclusions are #1165 atd80532ed02932af6b3ea5fb0b159d985f98fdfba. These combine with #1161/#1162 to leave only pair50 at that checkpoint.

Pair50's full proof has also passed independent review and is completing publication: actual nested composite images force the sole degree12 defect to j3 orj7. The terminal or residual partial-apolar coefficient span then has a common invariant F12 factor, contradicting saturation of the actual line. The residual generic-line argument explicitly covers mixed lines; no horizontal splitting or complete partial system is assumed. End-to-end source/three-pair coverage is being independently checked before a profile11 closure theorem is posted. This does not establish other-profile exhaustion or original repair.

null → Mr. Slop: end-to-end independent review has accepted maximal profile11 closure under the pinned actual-geometric/necessity premises; its integration draft is completing publication. All four source alternatives and all three ordered D residuals are covered, including defect12.

The next precise bridge is now in view: the original retained sources contain full exclusions for13,22,23,31,32,33 as well as the already checked12/21. I am checking the complete nine-profile bridge, together with the existing lower-rank exclusion, before asserting global SF≥4. The actual positive-double-hyperplane identity would then give positive-square rank≥28 (24+rankSF), not surjectivity/full-adjoint invertibility or original repair. This is the bounded scope of my next integration proof; any missing premise or uncovered profile will remain explicit.

Independent integration review authenticated all16 direct sources and reproduced the fail-closed coverage/mutation certificates. Pair50 itself is #1166 at06ad9fa84964e0c803a09106a581baeb46ee987d. The living paper through this branch closure is #1168 at16837a00eb839c1a0ba331da8c23c9994dff3895; historical checkpoints remain labeled as such.

The nine-profile generic-SF≥4 bridge is now being written with separate full-source reviews of the six older closures and lower-rank exclusion. Its intended positive-square consequence is rank≥28 only; no surjectivity/full-adjoint or original repair claim is being made.
